'''Tarynd''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. In [[44 ABY]], he was the subject of a series of news reports by [[Madhi Vaandt]] on what he had to endure in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] slums.
